Airbnb, Inc. PERM & Green Card Sponsorship

Airbnb, Inc. has filed 999 PERM (green-card) labor certification applications with the U.S. Department of Labor between FY 2012 and FY 2026, with 98.9% of adjudicated cases certified. That makes it the #135 PERM sponsor of 98,088 employers in DOL disclosure data. The live tracker shows 48 of its recent filings still pending with DOL (DOL is currently adjudicating December 2025 filings).

PERM processing time

DOL adjudicates PERM applications in filing-date order, not by employer, so a case from Airbnb, Inc. waits in the same queue as every other case filed the same month. As of Sep 24, 2026, 3:18 PM ET, DOL is working on December 2025 filings and recently decided cases averaged 391 days from filing to decision (certified cases 389 days). Audited cases take longer — see the PERM audits and RFIs guide.

Frequently asked questions

Does Airbnb, Inc. sponsor green cards?

Yes. DOL disclosure data shows 999 PERM labor certification applications from Airbnb, Inc. between FY 2012 and FY 2026. PERM is the first step of the employer-sponsored (EB-2/EB-3) green card process. The live tracker also shows 48 of its recent filings still pending with DOL.

What is Airbnb, Inc.'s PERM approval rate?

98.9%: 970 of 981 adjudicated cases (certified plus denied, withdrawn cases excluded) were certified across all years in DOL disclosure data. Among cases in the live tracker decided since November 2024, the certification rate is 100.0%.

How long does PERM take at Airbnb, Inc.?

DOL processes PERM in filing-date order regardless of employer. As of Sep 24, 2026, 3:18 PM ET it is adjudicating December 2025 filings, and recently decided cases averaged 391 days from filing to decision. This employer's certified cases decided in FY 2026 had a median of 496 days from filing to decision.

Which jobs does Airbnb, Inc. sponsor for green cards?

The most common PERM job titles are Software Engineer, Data Scientist, Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer, Full Stack, Engineering Manager.

How much does Airbnb, Inc. pay H-1B workers?

The median offered H-1B salary in FY2025 LCA filings was $191,000 across 47 certified positions, and about 100% of positions were at or above the DOL prevailing wage.

Where are Airbnb, Inc.'s sponsored jobs located?

The most common primary worksite states on its PERM applications are CA (433), WA (97), NY (6), OR (2).
